what: Rendered-layout evidence for every live calculator route. This is the artifact behind criterion B of `pnpm check:done`: AGENTS.md states that nothing in the test suite checks appearance, so a green suite says nothing about layout, and 'someone looked at it' does not survive a session ending. The CURRENT record is the three-viewport sweep below; the 2026-09-16/17 iframe sweep is kept under `historical` and is NOT a current claim.
supersedes: The 2026-09-16 iframe sweep at 390 and 1280 and the 2026-09-17 single-row pass. Their findings are retained verbatim under `historical` with their own dates, because several of them are still the clearest record of WHY a rule exists. Nothing under `historical` was re-measured on this export.

method.tool: Live pages in the CODEX in-app browser against the BUILT export served on loopback 3022. Codex, the independent verifier, performed this UI proof; the implementation owner (Claude) did not. Any earlier wording attributing the current sweep to a Claude in-app browser was wrong.
method.notThis: NOT same-origin iframes (the 2026-09-16 method), NOT screenshots generated from code, NOT mock DOM, NOT headless cropped windows. The distinction is load-bearing: see `rejectedApproachDated2026-09-16`.
method.verified: Every row's window.innerWidth was read at capture time and equalled the requested width. 76 routes x 3 viewports = 228 observations, 0 viewport mismatches.
method.scope: 76 unique calculator routes, enumerated from the links the rendered hub actually emits, listed individually in `rows` below. Derive the count from `content/calculators/registry.ts`, never from prose.
method.geometryIsNotAppearance: This sweep measured geometry and interacted with controls. Appearance is backed by the per-group screenshots that were captured AND inspected in earlier rounds, plus the four final mode-copy screenshots named in `appearanceEvidence`. A geometry pass is not visual acceptance.
method.rejectedApproachDated2026-09-16: chrome --headless --screenshot --window-size=390,844 . On this machine the headless window clamps to a minimum somewhere between 500 and 560 CSS px: captures at 390 and at 500 came back PIXEL-IDENTICAL in their left 390 columns, while 560 and above reflowed. So a 390-wide file from that path is a wider layout CROPPED, not a phone layout. It looks like valid evidence and is not. Any future harness must verify the layout width it claims, not just the image width.

Treat this as an in-app-browser evidence limitation, not an established application defect. The copy implementation is unchanged.

notProven.otherDomains: Colour contrast, focus order through long forms, every invalid field and every mathematical domain remain outside this evidence.

findings2026_09_16.noPageLevelOverflow: At 390 and at 1280, no route produced documentElement.scrollWidth greater than the viewport. Where a table is wider than the screen, the horizontal scroll is contained by the ResultTable wrapper, which is the intended behaviour.
findings2026_09_16.ruleVersusSymptom: docs section 3 requires mobileCards from five columns up. Measurement showed column count and rendered overflow are independent: lai-kep has 5 columns and does NOT overflow at 390, while vay-thuong-mai and lai-suat-thuc-te have 4 columns each and DID overflow. The threshold is a proxy for the symptom and is wrong in both directions. The two 4-column rows are deliberately NOT in WIDE_TABLE_PENDING, because that list is the allowlist for the RULE and is checked both ways. RE-MEASURED 2026-09-16 AFTER THE FIX: both report ZERO elements over 390; vay-thuong-mai went 485px -> 300px inside its 300px frame, and lai-suat-thuc-te moved to mobileCards so below md it renders no table at all. The finding itself still stands and should NOT be deleted.
findings2026_09_16.emphasisStableAcrossViewports: The same 30 rows shipped at least one <strong> at both viewports, with identical counts, so reading emphasis did not vary with layout. Dated 2026-09-16; not re-measured.
findings2026_09_16.causeWasHalfWrong: The earlier record said the cause on both 4-column rows was Vietnamese header length. Per-column measurement showed that held only for lai-suat-thuc-te. On vay-thuong-mai the binding constraints were an 8.5rem prose label floor misapplied to a column of 1,2,3 (136px for content needing 32px) and untyped money cells, which opted the table out of the compact reading and pinned each amount column at the width of 5.000.000.000 (125px). Shortening its headers alone moved the table 380px -> 380px. Widest-text-in-column is not the same as the reason the column is that wide.
findings2026_09_16.loanCompareRoutesFixed: so-sanh-khoan-vay and lai-co-dinh-hay-tha-noi are two routes over one component (LoanCompareCalculator), so one change to costBarsModel cleared the six-column docs-section-3 violation on both. Re-measured at a verified 390px viewport on 2026-09-16: both ZERO elements over 390. Fixing that table exposed a second overflow on the fixed-vs-floating route only: a FOUR-column payment table at 427px, caused by a composed option label held on one line by nowrap. Letting it wrap puts it at exactly 300px on both routes.
findings2026_09_16.noRowOverflows390: As of 2026-09-16 no live calculator route had an element wider than the 390px viewport. The list went 11 -> 9 -> 7 -> 0 across three changes: the two four-column rows, the two loan-comparison routes, and the seven-row P3/P4 shelf (eight tables: diem-pivot, gop-401k, toi-da-401k, ira-truyen-thong-hay-roth, nien-kim, rut-toi-thieu-bat-buoc and both tables on phan-tich-thu-nhap-huu-tri). Removed slugs and their last recorded counts: diem-pivot=9, gop-401k=13, toi-da-401k=31, phan-tich-thu-nhap-huu-tri=25, ira-truyen-thong-hay-roth=13, rut-toi-thieu-bat-buoc=27, nien-kim=10. An EMPTY list is the goal state, not a broken sweep — the guard in components/calc/wide-table-pending.test.ts had a non-vacuity floor asserting more than five overflowing rows, which would have gone red on completion, and it was removed for the same reason STATUTORY_UNDECLARED and NARROW_OVERFLOW_MEASURED lost theirs. The 2026-09-23 sweep independently found 0 elements over the viewport at 390 and 1440.
findings2026_09_16.remainingRuleDebt: WIDE_TABLE_PENDING still holds ONE entry, lai-kep: five columns, so it violates docs section 3, and measured to FIT at 390px. It is a rule debt with no rendered symptom, which is the clearest surviving evidence that column count and rendered overflow are independent.

ALL EIGHT new article figures were then seen in screenshots at 390 px (2026-09-17, second pass). Two further defects were found and fixed: C17's `visualReading` described THREE bars where the figure draws TWO — the budget-carried loan equals the loan used on that household, so the adapter drops the redundant bar — and C20's prose quoted only the algebraic 27,35 periods while the figure's marker says month 28.
